metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 iCalendar tool in `output/` (no third-party deps) with the required CLI:

- Build: `cmake -B build -S output && cmake --build build`
- Run:
  - `./build/ical parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
  - `./build/ical expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO-8601> --to <ISO-8601> --output <out.json>`

Key files:
- `output/CMakeLists.txt`
- `output/src/main.cpp` (CLI + parse/expand JSON emission)
- `output/src/ics.*` (RFC 5545 line unfolding + content-line parsing, RFC 6868 param decoding, TEXT unescape)
- `output/src/rrule.*` (RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE parsing + recurrence generation; RSCALE non-Gregorian warns `rscale_unsupported`)
- `output/src/timezone.*` (VTIMEZONE parsing + in-file TZID resolution with fold/gap warnings)
- `output/src/json.*` (minimal JSON writer)
- `output/src/datetime.*`, `output/src/model.*` (date math + warning/error helpers)
